The '''Buda Republic''' was a postwar republic associated with the territorial settlement that followed the [[Avant Great War]]. Current source material mentions it primarily because some territories promised to Khalindar during the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]] were instead placed under Buda or Belcantese control.

== Postwar Role ==

The Buda Republic appears in the source archive as one of the states created or recognized during the postwar settlement after the [[Vesperan Empire]] collapsed. Its role is important because it became part of the disputed settlement belt between the victorious powers, newly independent states, and Khalindar's wartime claims.

== Khalindarian Dispute ==

Khalindar argued that land assigned to Buda had been included in the red-line promises made by Solara in 1940. Solara and other postwar decision-makers treated the allocation as a stabilizing border decision after Vesperan collapse.

This made Buda a recurring reference in the [[Khalindarian reparations dispute]], even though the state itself was not the main opponent in Khalindarian narratives. Khalindar blamed Solara for the failed settlement.

== Canon Note ==

The exact geography and later status of Buda are not fixed by the current source archive. This page should be revised after the 2003 map alignment pass identifies whether Buda survived, merged, was renamed, or was absorbed by neighboring states.
